content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Clearwater

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree (high school diploma or equivalent) and completion of formal project management education—no prior work experience needed. This makes CAPM ideal for career-changers and early-stage professionals entering Clearwater's aerospace, healthcare, and supply-chain sectors seeking rapid credential advancement.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of PM Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp course. Our intensive format compresses project-management fundamentals into a concentrated schedule, letting you earn the required contact hours without extended classroom commitments while balancing work and personal obligations.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing coursework, submit your CAPM application directly to PMI with proof of education completion. Granite PM Academy provides all documentation needed. Pay the PMI exam fee at application, securing your eligibility to test within a defined window.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy offers targeted exam-prep support to reinforce PMBOK® Guide concepts and test-taking strategy. You'll sit for the proctored CAPM exam online, demonstrating mastery of project-management processes and terminology required for certification.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM credentials renew every three years by earning professional development units (PDUs) through training, volunteer work, or professional activity. Plan early to stay current and demonstrate ongoing commitment to project-management excellence in your career.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.
